case_name: S3-control Banff ref + Twain ref + pot ref
title: S3-control Banff ref + Twain ref + pot ref

turns.text: Make ONE photorealistic still image, widescreen 16:9, no text on it. rt3-banff.jpg is the PLACE; the scene must be exactly this view. rt3-twain.jpg is the MAN; he must look exactly like this, in colour. rt3-flowerpot.jpg is the POT; it must be exactly this pot. He stands on the foreground rock ledge, seen from the side, looking out over the lake, the pot beside his feet. He is the only person.

must_haves: The view is the Moraine Lake photo.
The man is recognisably the man in rt3-twain.jpg.
The pot is the pot in rt3-flowerpot.jpg.
